meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个视角一起辩论,把一个难题的方方面面都摆出来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正卡在没有标准答案的复杂选择上,需要有人把各方观点都替你摆清楚。
copy.tagline_en: Debate a hard question from several expert viewpoints before you commit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a complex choice has no clear answer and you want every angle weighed.

howto.what: 针对你的问题,选出 4~6 个思维原型(建筑师、反调者、未来学家等),让它们各按「立场/推理/风险/洞见」表态,最后产出综合:共识点、核心张力、盲点、推荐路径、信心级别和一个留给你思考的问题。
howto.when: 当你面临两难、取舍或没有明显答案的复杂选择,想从多个角度把一个问题想清楚,或说出 “council mode”、“mind council” 等词时触发。

say.text: 对我这个决定开一次 mind council:该不该换工作?
say.note: 会选出多个原型并给出综合结论

say.text: 用 quick council 快速分析一下这个方案要不要做。
say.note: 只用 3 个原型、回答更短

say.text: 用 devil's advocate mode 审一下我这个想法。
say.note: 每个原型都反过来论证

howto.what_en: It picks 4–6 thinking archetypes (Architect, Contrarian, Futurist, etc.). Each states a position, reasoning, risk and insight; then it synthesizes convergence, core tension, blind spot, recommended path, confidence and one question.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you face a dilemma, trade-off or hard choice with no obvious answer, want a problem explored from many angles, or say things like "council mode" or "mind council".

say_en.text: Run a mind council on this decision: should I change jobs?
say_en.note: It picks several archetypes and gives a synthesis

say_en.text: Use quick council to analyze whether to do this.
Put my idea through devil's advocate mode.
